_notes: Thai name: วรรณวิมล เจนอัศวเมธี. Nickname: June (จูน). Born in Samut Prakan Province. Won 'Go On Girl Star Search: My First Date' (2018), signed to GMMTV. Srinakharinwirot University grad (Computing for Communication, Dec 2022). Height listed as 5'4" (~163cm). Notable: Hana in F4 Thailand (2021-22), Luna in 23.5 (2024, ship: ViewJune), Tonnam in Whale Store xoxo (2025, ship: JuneMew). 1M+ IG followers. Twitter/X @junewanwimol19, TikTok @junewanwimol. Pair name with Mewnich officially written 'JuneMewnich' (sometimes shortened to JuneMew).

Full name from June's profile: Mewnich Nannaphas Loetnamchoetsakun. Former BNK48 member (per Fond's Rising Stars bio: 'Second ex-BNK48 idol to join GMMTV after Mewnich'). Birthday confirmed March 11 (turned 24 in 2026 → DOB 2002-03-11). INFJ personality. Plays Chomphu/Chom in Whale Store xoxo (2025) paired with June (ship: JuneMew). Co-leads Love's Echoes (2026, GMMTV) with June as JuneMewnich pair. Individual artist-profiles page exists but mostly empty (tweet archive only at https://thaiglhub.com/artist/mewnich-nannaphas/). Height not listed on thaiglhub.com.
